resources.string: A kitten met on the street
Skip
Tap to continue
Me
Another day of grabbing whatever food was around.
I was trudging home through an alley lit by a single street lamp.
…Mew.
In a cardboard box in the corner, a little kitten is staring right at me.
What should I do?
Crouch down and hold out a hand
Take a snack out of my bag
…Hi there. Don\'t be scared.
The kitten carefully climbs out of the box and sniffs my fingertips.
Hungry? Want some of this?
The kitten munches the snack, then looks up at me intently.
Then it pressed its head firmly against my hand.
…I think I\'ve just been chosen.
Hey, are you eating properly, meow?
…Huh? Did that cat just talk?
From now on, show me photos of what you eat. I\'ll eat with you.
If you eat well, I grow up big and strong, meow. If you skip meals… I\'ll get all wobbly too.
So starting today, let\'s eat together!
A cat that eats with me, huh. …Okay, let\'s do it.
But… I don\'t have a name yet.
Will you give me one?
